notes_for_editor: Thin record: one listing with the note 'Standing (Google Earth)' and one name in a GPS tower database. Brief's agency field held the status note (corrected above). On the Eastern US Lookouts page the Amite entry sits under a 'Misc. Notes - Virginia' heading in the page's index text, so its filing is unclear. Not found: the cached National Historic Lookout Register Mississippi list has no Amite entry; the firetower.org Mississippi former-site register (3 sites) has no Amite entry; the 2008 Amite County wildfire plan (https://www.mfc.ms.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/AMITE_CWPP.pdf) matched only cell and water tower lines when searched for 'tower' or 'lookout'. Brief coordinates were not checked against any source. The story is under 120 words because the evidence is this thin; the editor may hold, merge or drop it.
